concept.title: Renholm: The Gull Peak
concept.logline: On overcast, mysterious Renholm, you unravel the mechanisms to recover the lantern cores and restore the Gull Peak.
concept.source_prompt: Tropical Cove. tropical beach cove lagoon puzzle Beacon circuit
concept.player_fantasy: You are a wanderer who arrives at Harbour Village and becomes the one who brings the Gull Peak back to life.

key_locations.name: Harbour Village
key_locations.description: The start: the fishing village and its quay.

key_locations.name: Stilt Village
key_locations.description: Stilt Village: a village on the way out from Harbour Village.

key_locations.name: Castaway Camp
key_locations.description: Castaway Camp: a camp on the way out from Harbour Village.

key_locations.name: Sea Cave
key_locations.description: Sea Cave: a cave on the way out from Harbour Village.

key_locations.name: Gull Peak
key_locations.description: Gull Peak: a summit of Renholm, reached by the trail from Harbour Village.

characters.name: Keeper Wren
characters.description: Waits in Harbour Village and knows why the Gull Peak fell silent.

characters.name: Odo the Deckhand
characters.description: Follows you from Harbour Village and points out anything glinting nearby.

characters.name: Wreck Warden
characters.description: A wreck warden that never leaves its post, but lunges at anyone who gets close.

characters.name: Maren the Trader
characters.description: Trades gossip about Renholm for anything shiny.

characters.name: Sand Piper
characters.description: A harmless sand piper that bolts if you come too close.

objectives_outline: Learn the order of the circuit

actions.value: On overcast, mysterious Renholm, you unravel the mechanisms to recover the lantern cores and restore the Gull Peak.
Light the beacons in order: Castaway Camp → Stilt Village, then the Gull Peak.
Next in the circuit: the Castaway Camp.
The Castaway Camp flares; its beam points toward the Stilt Village.
Next in the circuit: the Stilt Village.
The circuit is closed. The Gull Peak answers.
The circuit runs Castaway Camp → Stilt Village.
Every beacon burns. Renholm: The Gull Peak is lit again.
You are badly hurt. Back off and recover.

nodes.speaker: Keeper Wren
nodes.text: So you've come to Harbour Village at last. I am Keeper Wren. On overcast, mysterious Renholm, you unravel the mechanisms to recover the lantern cores and restore the Gull Peak.

choices.text: What do you need from me?

nodes.speaker: Keeper Wren
nodes.text: Back again. Harbour Village is quieter while you're out there.

nodes.speaker: Keeper Wren
nodes.text: Go to Stilt Village, then Castaway Camp. Whatever still remembers Renholm: The Gull Peak is out there. Bring it back to me.

nodes.speaker: Keeper Wren
nodes.text: They say Harbour Village was built on what was left of an older place. Cheerful, even then. Ask the stones and they won't argue.

nodes.speaker: Keeper Wren
nodes.text: Stilt Village: Stilt Village: a village on the way out from Harbour Village.

nodes.speaker: Keeper Wren
nodes.text: You found something out there. I can see it on you. That's one piece of Renholm: The Gull Peak back where it belongs.

nodes.speaker: Keeper Wren
nodes.text: Castaway Camp: Castaway Camp: a camp on the way out from Harbour Village.

nodes.speaker: Odo the Deckhand
nodes.text: Odo the Deckhand circles your feet, then looks toward Stilt Village as if it already knows the way.

nodes.speaker: Odo the Deckhand
nodes.text: Odo the Deckhand hums quietly, the way it does before the weather turns.

nodes.speaker: Odo the Deckhand
nodes.text: It turns toward Stilt Village. Stilt Village: a village on the way out from Harbour Village.

nodes.speaker: Wreck Warden
nodes.text: Halt. Wreck Warden, of the watch at Harbour Village. Keep to the paths out there.

nodes.speaker: Wreck Warden
nodes.text: Still in one piece? Good. Keep it that way.

nodes.speaker: Wreck Warden
nodes.text: Deep water beyond the shore. Worst near Stilt Village.

nodes.speaker: Maren the Trader
nodes.text: Welcome to my corner of Harbour Village. Maren the Trader's wares have come a long way to get here.

nodes.speaker: Maren the Trader
nodes.text: Rope, oil, dried fruit, and maps of Renholm: The Gull Peak that are only a little wrong. Nothing you can't find for yourself, if you're patient.

nodes.speaker: Maren the Trader
nodes.text: People say lights move at Castaway Camp after dark. I don't go there myself.

nodes.speaker: Sand Piper
nodes.text: The sand piper freezes, watches you with one bright eye, and looks ready to bolt.
